assessment_summary.cou_name: Rank diffuser layouts and estimate zone-average downflow/uniformity in a Grade B cleanroom bay to inform next prototype build

evidence_keywords: Ansys Fluent 2023 R2; double precision; pressure-based segregated algorithm.
One patch applied (hotfix HF-2023R2-19) mid-campaign
Case and journal files on GitLab; tags v1.3 through v1.7
unit-tested probe extraction and stats
laminar Poiseuille and a backward-facing step yielded expected trends
observed ~1.9 order on grid halving for velocity in Poiseuille.
Three levels: 1.2M, 3.8M, and 7.5M cells
Velocity at probe P7 changed by 3.1% from 3.8M to 7.5M
Non-monotone trend at P11
Residual targets: 1e-5 (momentum), 1e-6 (continuity).
Final runs relaxed to 1e-4 for momentum to reach closure.
Monitor points (12 probes at 1.0 m height) plateaued to <0.3% drift
two runs restarted with different under-relaxation factors
Conditions for use:
Match blower mass flow in CFD within ±2% of the as-tested value
Do not use the current UQ coverage claim
The CFD model is not accepted for demonstrating compliance
Flow taken as steady with turbulence; no transient events
buoyancy neglected
realizable k-ε with scalable wall functions
Potential modeling gaps:
Target total supply: 1.20 kg/s at 20°C
redistributed 30/20/20/15/15% to mimic damper misbalance
Four returns held at -8 Pa relative to room
Upstream turbulence: 5% intensity and 0.1 m length scale
Full-scale mockup bay
16 probe locations in work zone; each averaged over 60 s
repeatability std dev ~0.02 m/s
Room held at neutral buoyancy; nominal 20°C, 101 kPa.
ambient 24–25°C for the first two runs
9 mm plenum height difference from model at two locations
Slide 4 stated 1.20 kg/s total supply for the validated case.
Test run “R2” used for comparison shows blower setpoint giving 1.00 kg/s total on the rotameter
mass flux integration over inlets in the output file sums to 1.01 kg/s.
Assumed 5% inlet TI; AHU spec sheet indicates 1–2%
mean absolute error 6% across 16 probes for the best layout
MAE 11.8% including all probes
88% of probes within ±20%
75% within ±20%

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: Primary target: zone-average velocity at 1.0 m; uniformity index (std dev / mean).
Gauge whether expected average downflow at 1.0 m above floor meets 0.45 m/s ± 20% guidance.
recovery time not validated
